author: God_of_Rum
quote: Majora’s Mask is an unforgettable triumph of atmosphere, storytelling, and game design. By trading the sprawling epic scale of its predecessor for an intimate, high-stakes world on the brink of destruction, it delivers one of the most emotionally resonant experiences in gaming history.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask 3D

author: God_of_Rum
quote: Grand Theft Auto IV is an unplayable piece of **** that completely fails at delivering the wholesome American Dream. I went in expecting a heartwarming tale of small-business ownership, and instead got a bleak, grey nightmare where nobody respects personal boundaries.

author: God_of_Rum
quote: Grand Theft Auto V is an unplayable piece of **** that actively punishes you for trying to live a quiet, productive life. I went in expecting a relaxing simulation of civic duty and urban planning, and instead got a completely broken mess.First, the traffic system is absolute ****. I spent three hours obeying speed limits and waiting at red lights, yet the game gave me zero **** achievements for my civic virtue, and the AI drivers repeatedly rear-ended me. There isn't even a goddamn turn-signal button.Second, the career progression is nonsensical. I tried to guide the middle-aged protagonist toward a peaceful life of yoga and real estate, only to be forced into unscheduled bank withdrawals and unauthorized helicopter acquisitions. You cannot file a single 1099 tax form, attend an HOA meeting, or dispute a **** zoning **** law enforcement AI is equally laughable. I accidentally bumped into a pedestrian while jogging, and within forty seconds, the city deployed attack helicopters to execute my ass—with no court summons or option to hire a municipal defense attorney.With zero farming mechanics, no polite small-talk dialogue trees, and music that is way too **** loud, GTAV fails at everything that matters. Save your money and enjoy the vastly superior tax code of real life.
